scope: Make waiting requests a compact actionable queue
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

projects-desktop-dark.png.task: Find and open a waiting request without a tall alert panel displacing projects.
projects-desktop-dark.png.observations: The waiting-request label and small count share a single heading line. The request title and check description remain readable with a clear arrow target; flatter edges and reduced padding free rail height. Dark and light text contrast remains clear. At 760×550 the queue fits above both project groups without clipping or overlap; no relationship geometry changed.
